title: Gold Wing Tour DCT (Performance Edition)
description: Representing Honda's prowess in the Luxury Grand Tourer class, the Honda Gold Wing Tour DCT (Performance Edition) is delivers unwavering high-speed stability and premier mile-eating comfort. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
